task_title: selection verbs skip an unparseable unrelated document and count it (row: one malformed file must not take the corpus offline)
task_criteria: PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_selection_skips_a_malformed_unrelated_document -q` prints `1 passed`. FAILIF: any other pass count, a failure, or a collection error.

PROOF: `PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_corpus_wide_verbs_still_refuse_a_malformed_document -q` prints `1 passed`. FAILIF: any other pass count, a failure, or a collection error.

PROOF: `bash -c 'export PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; d=/tmp/aug146-c3; rm -rf $d; mkdir -p $d; cp tests/fixtures/xml/specs/*.xml $d; printf "<spec xmlns=\"urn:auger:spec:1\"><requirement id=\"B\">" > $d/zz-broken.xml; python3 auger.py spec list $d --id AUG-REQ-030 >/tmp/aug146-c3.out 2>/tmp/aug146-c3.err; echo rc=$?; wc -l < /tmp/aug146-c3.out; grep -c unreadable /tmp/aug146-c3.err; python3 auger.py spec validate $d >/dev/null 2>&1; echo validate-rc=$?'` prints rc=0, then 1, then 1, then validate-rc=2. FAILIF: a nonzero list rc, zero or two selected rows, no 'unreadable' line on stderr, or a validate rc other than 2 (the defect must stay visible).
PROOF: `grep -c "Corpus-wide vs selection-scoped" docs/VERBS.md` prints 1. FAILIF: 0 — the selection-scoped vs corpus-wide rule is undocumented again.

PROOF: `bash -c 'export PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; python3 auger.py spec assemble tests/fixtures/xml/specs --id AUG-REQ-014 --format json --measure >/tmp/aug146-c4.json; echo rc=$?; grep -c documents_unreadable /tmp/aug146-c4.json'` prints rc=0 then 1. FAILIF: nonzero rc or no documents_unreadable counter in the measured report.
PROOF: `grep -c "tests/test_xml_specs.py" tests/gate.sh` prints 2. FAILIF: 0 or 1 — the pinning suite dropped out of the gate pytest arm.
PROOF: bash -c "git merge-base --is-ancestor dd9e4aee668a071de7eb48374111f179d5a621e2 HEAD; echo rc=$?" prints rc=0. FAILIF: any nonzero rc — the cited fix commit is absent from the graded history.

items.detail: Ran the exact command verbatim: output `rc=0` / `1` / `1` / `validate-rc=2`. /tmp/aug146-c3.out holds exactly one row (`AUG-REQ-030\trequirement\tactive\t2.0.0\tassembly.xml#AUG-REQ-030\tauger.spec`); /tmp/aug146-c3.err holds `spec: skipped 1 unreadable document(s) — this verb is selection-scoped; `auger spec validate` refuses the corpus` plus `spec:   zz-broken.xml: no element found: line 1, column 51 [invalid-xml]`.

items.criterion: PROOF: `grep -c "Corpus-wide vs selection-scoped" docs/VERBS.md` prints 1. FAILIF: 0 — the selection-scoped vs corpus-wide rule is undocumented again.
items.detail: `grep -c` -> `1`. The paragraph lives at docs/VERBS.md:692-703 and states which verbs are corpus-wide (validate/check/bundle) vs selection-scoped (list/assemble), the stderr count, the four `corpus.*` counters, and that the tolerance is exactly one code wide.

items.criterion: PROOF: `bash -c 'export PATH=...; python3 auger.py spec assemble tests/fixtures/xml/specs --id AUG-REQ-014 --format json --measure >/tmp/aug146-c4.json; echo rc=$?; grep -c documents_unreadable /tmp/aug146-c4.json'` prints rc=0 then 1. FAILIF: nonzero rc or no documents_unreadable counter in the measured report.
items.detail: Ran the exact command: output `rc=0` then `1`. The counter is emitted by `_spec_corpus_counts` (auger.py:12647-12658, `"documents_unreadable": len(unreadable)`) and called at auger.py:12856 for every assemble, measured or not.

items.criterion: PROOF: `grep -c "tests/test_xml_specs.py" tests/gate.sh` prints 2. FAILIF: 0 or 1 — the pinning suite dropped out of the gate pytest arm.
items.detail: `grep -c` -> `2`: tests/gate.sh:157 (the comment naming the suite) and tests/gate.sh:206 (the pytest arm that actually runs `tests/test_xml_specs.py`).

items.criterion: PROOF: bash -c "git merge-base --is-ancestor dd9e4aee668a071de7eb48374111f179d5a621e2 HEAD; echo rc=$?" prints rc=0. FAILIF: any nonzero rc — the cited fix commit is absent from the graded history.
items.detail: Ran it: `rc=0`; `git log -1 dd9e4ae` -> `dd9e4ae fix(spec): selection verbs skip an unparseable document and count it (AUG-146)`. `git show --stat dd9e4ae` touches auger.py (+137), docs/VERBS.md (+13), tests/test_xml_specs.py (+152).

items.criterion: Corpus-wide verbs (validate, check, bundle, render) still refuse a malformed document with exit 2 and name the file, so the tolerance did not leak into the corpus-wide path.
items.detail: On a corpus of tests/fixtures/xml/specs/*.xml plus a truncated zz-broken.xml: `spec check` -> check-rc=2, `spec bundle` -> bundle-rc=2, `spec render` -> render-rc=2, `spec validate` -> validate-rc=2, each printing `spec error (invalid-xml): zz-broken.xml: no element found: line 1, column 51`. Code: `selection_scoped = command in ("list", "assemble")` (auger.py:12719) is the only place `tolerate_unreadable=True` is passed (auger.py:12725-12727); the else branch calls the strict `load_spec_corpus(a.root)` (auger.py:12734).

items.criterion: The tolerance is exactly one code wide: only `invalid-xml` is skipped; wrong namespace/root, unsupported schema-version, DOCTYPE/ENTITY and include failures still refuse on the selection verbs too.
items.detail: auger.py:7883 `SPEC_TOLERATED_UNREADABLE = ("invalid-xml",)`; auger.py:8053 `if not (tolerate_unreadable and exc.code in SPEC_TOLERATED_UNREADABLE): raise`. `_spec_read_document` (auger.py:7938-7979) raises external-entity-forbidden / unsupported-namespace / invalid-root / unsupported-schema-version / missing-document-metadata, none tolerated; `_spec_include_target` (auger.py:8222-8244) and `_spec_collect` (auger.py:8467-8470) still raise unresolved-include. tests/test_xml_specs.py:1168-1196 pins the schema-version and DOCTYPE cases on `list` (ran: 1 passed).

items.criterion: The skip is reported, not silent: both selection verbs print the count and the offending file on stderr while stdout stays parseable, and the JSON `corpus` counters agree with what was actually read.
items.detail: `spec list --id AUG-REQ-014` -> list-rc=0 with stderr `spec: skipped 1 unreadable document(s) — this verb is selection-scoped; ...` + `spec:   zz-broken.xml: no element found: line 1, column 51 [invalid-xml]`; `spec assemble --id AUG-REQ-014 --format json` -> asm-rc=0, same two stderr lines, stdout still `json.loads`-able with corpus {'documents_discovered': 4, 'documents_parsed': 3, 'documents_selected': 2, 'documents_unreadable': 1}. Emitters: `_spec_report_unreadable` (auger.py:12629-12644, called at auger.py:12735) and `_spec_corpus_counts` (auger.py:12647-12658).

items.criterion: The measured assembly report keeps its documented shape when a document is skipped (all `--measure` keys plus the `corpus` block present, rc=0).
items.detail: `spec assemble <corpus-with-zz-broken.xml> --id AUG-REQ-014 --format json --measure` -> asm-measure-rc=0; keys ['blocks','blocks_indexed','blocks_parsed','corpus','counts','documents_read','elapsed_ms','input_bytes','output_bytes','report_schema_version','schema_version','selection'], corpus={'documents_discovered':4,'documents_parsed':3,'documents_selected':2,'documents_unreadable':1}. Regression surface green: `pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -q` -> `58 passed in 1.16s`; `pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/test_xsd_conformance.py tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py tests/test_spec_validate_obligations.py tests/test_spec_assembly_report.py tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py tests/test_spec_context.py tests/test_spec_render.py -q` -> `147 passed in 9.16s`.
